notes.title: Small Patch June 2021
notes.content:
Sorry it has been so long since an update. Heavy real world problems needed lifting.

todays additions:
-Fixed a save / party menu cursor bug.
-Locked the inventory slots that extend beyond the current inventory limits.
(In the future the inventory maximum can be extended)
-Dancer 'Resourcefulness' triggers on item use ('55% chance')
-Drop item bug fixed.

Been planning 'The Middle' it's gonna be bigger than The Beginning, and a few other small things.

Reworking some of the calculations in the future. Will create a slightly more difficult combat experience and more meaningful character stat growth.

notes.title: March 2021 Update and fixes
notes.content:
-Completed the instruction booklet. It currently can be accessed on the Title screen of the game and explains most of the game in detail.
-Fixed a few Dancer bugs

-Added a few sound effects

Custom Keybinding

notes.title: Update Notes: Feb 13 2021
notes.content:
Added controller functionality.

Should auto connect most supported PC gamepads.

Implementing rebinding right now.


-Fixed a story bug with the engineer in the mountain highway.

notes.title: More bug fixes!
notes.content:
Rathe was streamed for 5 hours and I found a bunch of stuff to fix.

Fixed:
-Long Hero names in the combat display.
-Mimic Confusion cloud attack looped.
-Can no longer skip the first story act trigger.
-Disabled all the PUB shops. (for now)
-Added a skill description in the Skill Web tab in the Party Management menu
-Fixed stat displays in the party menu when equipping items using the shop buttons
-Fixed the over-world character displaying clones of other party members during story events. The over-world hero switches back to the main hero when a story event is triggered.
-Added Action Highlights to combat, it shows what action has been chosen by a hero.
-Fixed a glitch where you could select the same hero to do different actions repeatedly.
-Fixed the Thief skills :Snatch Mug and Jackpot; They now steal gold and items properly from the enemies.


In Progress:
-Improving Input & Keybinding system
-Instruction Booklet (in-Game user manual)
-More variety in enemy encounters
-Tool-tip for stats in the party menu


I haven't gotten auto updating / patching to work perfectly yet :( You'll need to redownload the game to see any of the changes. Sorry. :(


If you encounter any problems contact us @ support@fistsofdestinygames.ca

-SuperKash
